mechanism: Propylthiouracil inhibits warfarin metabolism via CYP2C9 inhibition and increases warfarin effects by enhancing vitamin K antagonism in the hypercoagulable state of hyperthyroidism, elevating INR and bleeding risk.
action: Monitor INR closely with frequent testing; consider warfarin dose reduction; coordinate with endocrinology; consider switching to direct oral anticoagulants if feasible; educate patient on bleeding precautions.
